map-scale.def: The ratio between a distance on a map and the same distance on the ground, such as 1:50,000. A large-scale map shows a small area in detail; a small-scale map shows a large area with less detail.

scale-of-analysis.def: The size of the unit that data describe or that a question is about: global, regional, national or local. It is set by the data, not by the size of the map.

global-scale.def: The scale of analysis that looks at the whole world, comparing places across it.

regional-scale.def: The scale of analysis that looks at a part of the world made of several countries, such as South Asia or Latin America.

national-scale.def: The scale of analysis that looks at one country as a whole, with one value for each country.

local-scale.def: The scale of analysis that looks at a part of a country, such as a province, state, city or neighborhood. Data for parts of a country are also called subnational.
